plausibility.question: P1 gravity
plausibility.answer: In use +Z is horizontal and faces the user (spec section 2); the housing hangs on its rear slab, which is the mounting flange, through four M3 inserts at (±44, ±44) whose bosses are tied into the slab with R 0.6 roots, and the brew load runs ear to lug underside to cup wall to slab to carrier through one continuous section.

plausibility.question: P2 function chains
plausibility.answer: OD-G04's Ø20.06 hub passes the Ø26.000 x 5.000 opening with 2.970 mm of radial room and ends 2.39 mm inside the slab, so the water connection is reached from the rear face (A-24); the two OEM screws come from the rear through the Ø3.800 holes into pair B (0.540 mm clear) and pair A passes the two Ø9.000 lobes (1.010 mm clear).

plausibility.question: P3 moving parts
plausibility.answer: The portafilter enters along -Z through three 66 deg gaps (>= 0.4945 mm over 25 poses), turns 62.24 deg at depth (>= 0.5027 mm over the 19 rotation poses outside the last 0.45 mm of travel, 0.2765 mm at the stop block) and seats 0.45 mm to contact; my (clock, depth) grid shows the turn frees up only once the rim is below -11.45, which is the bayonet's own sequence.

plausibility.question: P4 human factors
plausibility.answer: One opening, one insertion direction, three ears into three gaps ended by a stop block; screws, inserts and the water connection are all reached from the flat square rear face, and the handle swings clear of the housing at the locked clock in the assembly section.

plausibility.question: P5 absurdity next to a real product
plausibility.answer: A Ø86.2 cup on a 100 mm square flange 28.24 tall with a keyhole plate and two screw seats reads like the OEM group head it reproduces; the one thing a domain engineer would ask about is the 5.00 mm slab where the OEM has 2.50, which A-24 records as open.

plausibility.question: P6 nothing floating, embedded, mirrored or upside-down
plausibility.answer: One solid, 92 faces, no naked edge; lug 1 starts at 336 deg counter-clockwise as spec section 2 fixes it, the mouth is at +3.3000001 and the rear face at -24.9400001, the keyhole lobes lie at 359.5 / 179.0 deg and the pair-B recesses at 119.3 / 304.0 deg in the top section, and OD-G04 seats flange-down while OD-G10 enters rim-first.

findings.required: 15 bar on a Ø51 basket (3.06 kN) on the OD-T01 bench rig
findings.at: the three lugs and their roots
findings.risk_basis: No geometric check answers a strength row; A-21 records that no strength calculation exists and spec section 5 defers the row to a bench test that has not been run, so the evidence cannot tell whether the part holds.
findings.fix_direction: Run the OD-T01 bench test on a printed part and record it, or have the Usta accept the row knowingly (D-022); nothing in the CAD closes it.

findings.required: = 0 at the designed contact of the three ear tops on the lug undersides
findings.risk_basis: Spec 1.3 defines the locked pose as the first contact, so the gated pair reads 0 and U-03 passes as ratified; but A-25's ears at 120.5 / 120.5 / 119 deg cannot all meet a symmetric 120 deg lug pitch, so the 3.06 kN brew load starts on one lug and spreads only after 0.09 mm is taken up somewhere - the gasket (A-27) is the candidate and is unmeasured, and REQ-12 is untested.
findings.fix_direction: Clock the three lugs to the measured ear pitch, or confirm on the donor that the gasket takes up 0.09 mm before load; retire A-25 and A-27 first.

findings.required: interference <= 0 mm3 (the ratified row answers by clearance instead, A-28)
findings.at: housing | OD-G10 at the locked pose
findings.risk_basis: clearance reads 0 both for a pair that touches and for one that interpenetrates without the nearest points parting, and the OD-G10 input fails brep_valid (A-28), so no volume check can rule an overlap out; the 55-pose path, nothing under 0.2765 mm until the last 0.45 mm of travel which is a pure translation, is the strongest evidence available and it is indirect.
findings.fix_direction: Rebuild OD-G10 as a sound solid in open-dedica and re-run interference at the locked pose; no change to this part is implied.

findings.required: a root fillet on each lug side face, ladder [0.8, 0.6, 0.4]
findings.at: first sharp concave edge (33.9188, 15.0308, -3.3700); seven lug root edges, 48 sharp concave edges in the part
findings.risk_basis: The lug root is the section the whole brew load passes through (A-21) and it is left sharp, a stress riser in an FDM part whose layers run across it; no section 5 row reads these edges and spec section 4 C1 does not state a fillet, so it is not a missing spec feature, but REQ-12 is the row that would find it.
findings.fix_direction: Cut the lug side faces back from the bore by the fillet radius so a round can be built there, or carry the sharp root into the OD-T01 test and judge it from the result.

findings.risk_basis: The delivered mesh is finer than the row asks and passes the gated value (0.0094758 <= 0.01); measured on the same B-rep at the row's own 0.01 mm the sagitta comes out 0.0431441, so the row as written cannot meet its own sagitta limit on this geometry and the deviation is the only way to pass it.
findings.fix_direction: Amend U-07's stated tolerance for this job to 0.002 mm so the row is self-consistent; the delivered file needs no change.

findings.at: (±44, ±44), z -24.94 to -19.24: the bore breaks through the boss top
findings.risk_basis: A-17's 5.70 mm hole in a 5.00 mm slab plus a 0.70 mm boss leaves no depth margin and each bore is open at both ends, so an insert pressed past flush leaves the far end; the opening sits at r 62.2, outside the cup wall at r 43.1, so it is on the flange's front face and not a water path.
findings.fix_direction: Raise the boss 0.3 to 0.5 mm, or state the insert seating depth in the print notes.

findings.required: >= 0.30 outside the last 0.5 mm of approach (this pose lies 0.45 mm from the final one, so the row exempts it at >= 0)
findings.at: (-23.6314, -21.0993, -10.5200) stop-block face against the ear leading edge, at the locked clock
findings.risk_basis: This is the tightest non-contact gap anywhere on the lock path and it is exempt only by the 0.5 mm approach rule; A-04's ±0.25 deg on the lug starts moves it by 0.138 mm (0.25 deg x 31.68 mm), so a clocking error changes the stop angle, not the fit, and nothing overlaps at either end of that band.
findings.fix_direction: Retire A-04 and A-14 with a protractor on the donor cup before the first print.

least_sure_answers.item: 1. Only one ear top touches at the measured locked pose (0 / 0.0903189 / 0.0210511)
least_sure_answers.answer: Confirmed independently: my own bisection puts first contact at rim z -11.2510287 and my own sector cut of the housing reads 0.0000000 / 0.0903189 / 0.0210511 mm on lugs 1 / 2 / 3. The ratified row gates one pair and it reads 0, so U-03 passes; the load-path consequence is finding F2, rated MEDIUM.

least_sure_answers.item: 2. lug_starts_hi (+0.25 deg) puts the U-03(a) probe out of band through the stop-block pair
least_sure_answers.answer: The sensitivity is real and I measured its nominal side: the ear leading edge stands 0.2764566 mm from the stop block at the locked clock, and 0.25 deg at r 31.68 is 0.138 mm, the number the designer's sweep reports. I did not re-run the sweep (one review, no rebuild). The delivered part at nominal reads 0.1997125 mm on the probe, inside [0.19, 0.21]. Finding F7, LOW.

least_sure_answers.item: 3. Everything that rests on OD-G10's boolean
least_sure_answers.answer: Confirmed: common_volume refuses the pair (OD-G10 brep_valid 0, BOPAlgo_InvalidCurveOnSurface) exactly as A-28 says, so the row stands on distance alone. My own 55-pose path and 66-pose (clock, depth) grid add that nothing on the way in comes under 0.2765 mm until the last 0.45 mm, which is a pure translation - strong but indirect. Finding F3, UNKNOWN.

least_sure_answers.item: 4. The smaller ones: D-05b's zero depth margin and the bore opening on the cup floor, the bead and pair-B margins, the sharp lug roots, A-14's ±0.10 band
least_sure_answers.answer: Depth 5.7000000 with zero margin and a through bore: confirmed, finding F6 - but the opening is at r 62.2, outside the cup wall at r 43.1, so it is on the flange's front face, not 'a hole into the wet side' as the REPORT calls it. Bead 0.5236629 (+0.0237) and pair B 0.5400000 (+0.040): confirmed. Sharp lug roots: confirmed, 48 sharp concave edges, finding F4. A-14: my own first contact is -11.2510287, inside the ±0.10 band by 0.0489713, so the underside level (A-05) has about 0.05 mm of room before the row fails.
